parameters.query: SELECT id, name, domain, ats_platforms, ats_slug FROM global_companies WHERE is_active = true AND array_length(ats_platforms, 1) > 0 AND ats_slug IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name

parameters.text:
=You are a precise job classifier for B2B SaaS tools. Classify this job:

Title: {{ $json.title }}
Description: {{ $json.description.substring(0, 500) }}

Categories:
- infrastructure: DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure
- security_compliance: Security Engineer, AppSec, CISO, Compliance, SOC2/HIPAA roles
- data_ai: Data Engineer, ML Engineer, AI/ML, Analytics
- go_to_market: Sales Engineer, SDR, Marketing, Growth
- leadership: VP, Director, Head of X, CTO, CEO
- irrelevant: Designer, HR, Finance, Admin

Output ONE word only (e.g., infrastructure). No explanation.

parameters.query: =SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM signals WHERE company_id = '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.company_id }}' AND signal_type = 'hiring' AND signal_title = '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.title }}' AND DATE(signal_date) = CURRENT_DATE

=INSERT INTO signals (company_id, company_name, signal_type, signal_title, signal_url, signal_date, signal_category, raw_summary) VALUES ('{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.company_id }}'::uuid, '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.company_name }}', 'hiring', '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.title }}', '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.url }}', current_date, '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.category }}', '{{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.title }}({{ $('Split for Signal Processing').item.json.location || "Remote" }})') ON CONFLICT (company_id, signal_type, signal_title, signal_date) DO NOTHING
